description: Plan article ideas, generate articles and analyse search performance for your ContentPulse websites.

interface.longDescription: Plan, create and measure content for your website without leaving ChatGPT. ContentPulse uses your connected website's existing content and topics to suggest article ideas that don't overlap with what you've already published. Review the ideas first and save only the ones you choose. Rank your saved ideas by how shareable they are. Pick an idea and a target word count, and ContentPulse opens it ready to generate the full article in your dashboard. For published articles, analyse search performance from your Google Search Console data to see what's working and what to improve.
defaultPrompt: Create five ideas for my website. Check for overlap and wait for my choices before saving.
Find article opportunities from my website and Search Console data.
How is my latest article performing in search?

publication.release_notes: Updated the listing to describe the full workflow: article ideas, article generation and search performance analysis. Added a search performance starter prompt.
